_about: Settings compatibility rules, read by the compatibility tests. Policy and examples: CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Settings compatibility'.

config.toml.version: the schema version, written by the build, not a setting
config.toml.overlay.corner_version: migration marker: any other value re-runs the corner migration
config.toml.recording.audio_sources[game].id: a source's identity, the key the source is matched by
config.toml.recording.audio_sources[game].kind: the game source is always kind game
config.toml.recording.audio_sources[game].device: the game source has no device
config.toml.recording.audio_sources[game].exe: the game source follows the detected game, no exe
config.toml.recording.audio_sources[mic].id: a source's identity, the key the source is matched by
config.toml.recording.audio_sources[mic].kind: the microphone is always kind input
config.toml.recording.audio_sources[mic].exe: an input source has no exe
